title: Davidson Fellows Scholarship
description: Awarded to students 18 and under who have completed a significant piece of work in STEM, literature, music, or philosophy.

title: Prudential Emerging Visionaries
description: Recognizes young people ages 14–18 creating innovative solutions to financial or societal challenges in their communities.

title: Gloria Barron Prize for Young Heroes
description: Honors inspiring, public-spirited young people ages 8–18 who have made a significant positive difference to people and the environment.

title: Carson Scholars Fund
description: Awarded to students in grades 4–11 with a 3.75+ GPA who demonstrate strong humanitarian qualities (requires school nomination).

title: Stanford Pre-Collegiate Summer Institutes
description: Intensive single-subject online summer enrichment courses in STEM, humanities, writing, and business for grades 8–11.

title: Johns Hopkins Center for Talented Youth (CTY)
description: Advanced academic summer programs and online courses in math, science, computer science, and humanities.

title: iD Tech Camps
description: Summer camps in coding, AI, robotics, and game design hosted at major university campuses nationwide.

title: Coolidge Scholarship
description: Prestigious, non-partisan merit scholarship covering full tuition, room, board, and expenses—open exclusively to high school juniors.

title: QuestBridge College Prep Scholars
description: Equips high-achieving, low-income juniors with awards, college admissions coaching, and summer program scholarships.

title: Horatio Alger Association National Scholarship
description: Supports high school juniors who have faced and overcome great obstacles in their lives and demonstrate critical financial need.

title: National Merit Scholarship Program (PSAT/NMSQT)
description: Academic competition for recognition and college scholarships entered by taking the PSAT/NMSQT in October of junior year.

title: Research Science Institute (RSI) at MIT
description: Premier cost-free, six-week summer science and engineering program combining coursework in scientific theory with off-campus research.

title: Simons Summer Research Program (Stony Brook)
description: Hands-on research apprenticeship where rising seniors join research groups in science, math, or engineering at Stony Brook University.

title: Garcia Summer Scholars (Stony Brook)
description: Seven-week intensive summer program offering high school students the opportunity to perform independent polymer science research.

title: NIH High School Summer Internship Program (HS-SIP)
description: Full-time biomedical research internships at the National Institutes of Health (applicants must be 17+ by the start date).

title: Bank of America Student Leaders
description: Eight-week paid summer internship at a local nonprofit organization plus an all-expenses-paid leadership summit in Washington, D.C.

title: MITES Summer (MIT)
description: Six-week residential STEM immersion program at MIT for rising seniors from underrepresented or underserved backgrounds.

title: American Legion Boys State / Girls State
description: Week-long participatory summer program in civics, government, and leadership for rising high school seniors.

title: Yale Young Global Scholars (YYGS)
description: Two-week academic enrichment sessions at Yale University covering politics, STEM, literature, and global affairs.

title: Coca-Cola Scholars Program
description: Achievement-based scholarship awarded to graduating high school seniors recognized for their capacity to lead and serve.

title: The Gates Scholarship
description: Highly selective, last-dollar scholarship for outstanding, Pell-eligible minority high school seniors.

title: Regeneron Science Talent Search (STS)
description: The nation's oldest and most prestigious science and math competition for high school seniors submitting original research.

title: Jack Kent Cooke Foundation College Scholarship
description: Undergraduate scholarship program available to high-achieving high school seniors with financial need.

title: Elks Most Valuable Student (MVS) Scholarship
description: Judged on scholarship, leadership, and financial need; open to any high school senior who is a U.S. citizen.

title: Burger King Scholars Program
description: Awards scholarships to high school seniors based on grade point average, work experience, extracurriculars, and community service.
